item.title: Celebrating Greece’s Laiki Agora in the cooler months
item.description: The laiki agora, or outdoor neighborhood market, is a wonderful adventure to explore any time of year. item.title: Turkey Set to Miss Deadline for Inclusion in EU’s SAFE Defense Mechanism
item.description: Turkey will miss the deadline to join the EU’s €150 billion SAFE defense mechanism, as the European Commission says its application cannot be processed in time. Political resistance from Greece, Cyprus, and France further complicates Ankara’s bid, while UK negotiations collapsed over funding demands, leaving Canada as the only partner still in talks. item.title: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese Marries Jodie Haydon in Historic Ceremony at The Lodge
item.description: In a historic first, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese wed Jodie Haydon at The Lodge in Canberra on November 29, 2025, becoming the first Australian prime minister to marry while in office. The secretive ceremony, attended by close family and friends, featured personal vows, a Romance Was Born gown for Haydon, and an MJ Bale suit for Albanese. item.title: Airbus Software: Which Companies Withdrew A320s for Inspection – What Aegean Announced
item.description: Airbus has launched one of its largest-ever recalls, ordering urgent software updates on ~6,000 A320-family aircraft due to a risk of uncommanded pitch-down triggered by intense solar radiation. Hundreds of flights are at risk, with Avianca halting ticket sales and several airlines grounding planes overnight.
